title: Postoperative Delirium a prospective descriptive study on the Intensiv Care ward of the University Hospital Pius
summary:
Postoperative Delrium is a complication that is  quite common after an operation. This study will focus on the occurrence of Delrium after general/visceral surgery with a planned length of stay of on the Intensiv Care ward of >24 hours. The main goal of this study is to describe how often a Delir occurs on our Intensiv Care ward. This data is needed to look at planned structural changes and their effect on our new Intensiv Care ward and the occurrence of Delirium. 

A secondary endpoint will focus on identifying potential risk factors to develop a score/tool which could be easily used in the Pre Operative Assessment of patients.
conditions: Delirium, not induced by alcohol and other psychoactive substances

interventions.name: General and Visceral Surgery Patients with a planned admission to the Intensiv Care ward after an operation with a minimal Length of Stay of >24 Hours.
